Alright, I'll teach you the basics of piloting an AT.
First, hop into that AT up ahead.
It ain't just the AT. You gotta be able to handle yourself, too.
Whoa there! Don't go firing that gun wildly.
Right, let's start with the basics: moving your AT.
Not bad, you've already got the hang of it.
Try out roller dashing and walking.
First, the roller dash. Switch to your gliding wheels.
Knowing when to walk and when to roller dash is key.
Roller dashing is the basis of AT movement. Learn to use it well!
For emergency evasion, an AT can do a short but faster-than-usual roller dash.
ATs don't have shields. Use this to dodge bullets.
To aim at distant enemies, switch your turret.
Okay, Chirico. Now shoot the target in front of you.
Okay, Chirico. Now take down the enemy in front of you.
Some skill... Just what I expected of you...
Hey, what's wrong? Gotten rusty after so long out of an AT?
Some ATs are equipped with more than one weapon.
More weapons is always better, but they're useless if you can't use 'em.
Switch weapons to suit the enemy type and situation.
A gun with no ammo is useless. Go find a new weapon, quick.
What do you do if you run clean out of weapons?
The Scopedog comes with an arm punch mechanism.
Point is, you punch the other guy's lights out!
There's a beat-up AT here, just right for practice. Give it a go!
An AT breaks down when it's badly damaged. Switch to another early.
On the battlefield, ATs are disposable. Treat yours well, but sometimes switching is quicker.
Take out the guy inside, and you can steal his AT, too.
Aiming for specific parts to get an edge is another option.
Some of the weapons lying around should be usable.
Bet you can use that one too.
That's it, Chirico. If it's usable, use it.
Watch your surroundings. Don't end up in the middle of the enemy before you know it.
Last up: how to use Mission Disks.
A disk has several programs set on it. Try using them.
Use a Mission Disk when the timing's right, got it?
That covers the basics of piloting an AT.
The rest is up to you, Chirico. Live or die, it's on you.
A Real Battle?! I never set up a match like that!
Whoa! Old man Gotho, that's a bold move!
Chirico! It's for real! We've been set up!
Place your bets! Now's the time to cash in!
Okay! Miss Coconna bets a whole one Gildan on Chirico!
Hmph! You didn't have to say "whole"!
Once we get the money, we're done here!
Chirico, we got the money! We're pulling out!
What's he up to? That guy...
Hey, this is bad... Something weird just showed up.
Stick around here and you'll die a hundred times over!
Chirico, we're going ahead! Hurry up and finish it!
That's the Red Shoulder for ya. Unreal...
Hey, Chirico! If you're sneaking into the Security Police, now's your chance!
Chirico, together we're an easy target.
Thugs or not... they seem to know how to fight...
They mean to drive us out...
We go all the way underground.
Only a few know this, but an underground express line runs beside the machine room.
It's... beyond the wall at the end here!
Chirico! Move up and draw their attention!
Of course. Go see how tough the Vilar are.
Fyana! It's me! Don't you know me?
Fyana... As a PS, you should know... It's me! Chirico!
You can't have forgotten! Why fight me?!
Fool! You'll wake a sleeping giant!
Look! This place was a Vilar nest after all!
Protect the boat at all costs!
